result: At exact rmcp-v3.1.4 release source, the typed wire params expose no first-class task generation, version, expected-status/value, CAS precondition, or historical fence. GetTaskParams contains only _meta and taskId. UpdateTaskParams contains _meta, taskId, and inputResponses. CancelTaskParams contains _meta and taskId. Therefore an application cannot bind update/cancel to a stock typed generation/version field because no such field exists in these request params. Generic _meta remains an extension surface and is not treated as a stock task-wide fence by this finding.
